cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Be Right in Retrospect
cards.instruction: Perform certainty by reinterpreting every surprise as something your earlier words were obviously predicting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When I said the evening would flow, I meant this kitchen flood. I taught you to listen to the exact words before guessing what comes next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're remembering the conversation now. Good. And what are we all talking about? The water. Write that beside my prediction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You didn't predict a burst pipe.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I said something would have to open up before the evening improved. Read your notes the way I showed you; put 'pipe' beside that bit. Then hand me the mop.
